essence: The rite employs the Sammohana meter and takes Gāyatrī as its deity.
The six limbs are constructed from the root mantra combined with six long vowels.
The practitioner should place the previously mentioned five arrows and perform the meditation.
The meditation visualizes a beautifully adorned goddess who enchants the three worlds.
The goddess is further visualized as agitating, moon-like, and paralyzing.
